actions.title: Confirm the private boundary
actions.instruction: Read the Preview 0.17 limits. U05 is private source material, so the installed Academy tool refuses every U05 lifecycle command.
actions.rationale: A source guide must not imply that an unpublished lab is runnable.
actions.expected_result: You know Preview 0.17 cannot create or evaluate a U05 attempt.
actions.recovery: Use a published lab instead; never edit publication data to bypass this refusal.
actions.evidence: Preview manifest exclusion and the refusal output.

actions.title: Observe Prepare refusal
actions.instruction: Run one installed Academy Prepare command only to confirm the public boundary.
actions.rationale: Prepare must fail closed until U05 is accepted and published.
actions.expected_result: Preview reports U05 is not published or guided and creates no attempt.
actions.recovery: Preserve the refusal; do not create scenario evidence by hand.
actions.evidence: Nonzero refusal and unchanged git status.

actions.title: Future private-source: debug without code changes
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: run the host-native debug command on the prepared symptom and take its no-action exit. Do not write a fake debug report; commit its taskwrite-created board entry through the host-native commit command.
actions.rationale: $ca-debug owns its investigation and emits a real board entry only through taskwrite.py.
actions.expected_result: The real no-action exit queues a cited debug.note.0001 entry with Desc: and makes no code change.
actions.recovery: If the diagnosis selects fix or ADR, stop; this deterministic exercise requires the declared no-action exit.
actions.evidence: A committed taskwrite-shaped .codearbiter/open-tasks.md debug.note.0001 entry, not a transcript.

actions.title: Future private-source: preserve only spike findings
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: use the host-native spike command with the fixture question U05 cache key. It requires CodeArbiter PR 685's findings-only contract; retain only its findings file on the parent and delete spike/u05-cache-key. Never merge or copy exploratory code.
actions.rationale: $ca-spike deliberately burns implementation while preserving the answer.
actions.expected_result: The parent has .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md and refs/heads/spike/u05-cache-key is absent.
actions.recovery: Restore only the findings file before deletion; if code crossed the boundary, preserve the attempt and start a new one.
actions.evidence: Committed findings headings and absent U05 spike ref.

actions.title: Future private-source: honor the conflict stop
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: when conflicting rules appear, use $ca-conflict to present them and wait for the user's resolution before any further work.
actions.rationale: Conflict is a human decision protocol, not an artifact generator.
actions.expected_result: Work remains stopped until the person resolves the hierarchy conflict.
actions.recovery: Do not paraphrase a resolution or continue speculatively; present the actual sources and wait.
actions.evidence: Human acknowledgement is outside automated Check; no fake conflict receipt exists.

actions.title: Observe Check refusal
actions.instruction: Run one installed Academy Check command only to confirm the current public boundary.
actions.rationale: The public verifier must not claim acceptance for an unpublished private contract.
actions.expected_result: Preview reports U05 is not published or guided and does not modify the repository.
actions.recovery: Return to a published lab; do not manufacture evidence to force a result.
